tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Antara Purukul Senior Living Limited ("APSLL"), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company: An assessment of APSLL pertaining to Assessment Year 2022-23 was completed and a demand notice of ₹ 1,113.19 lakhs was issued by the Income Tax Department. APSLL has filed an appeal against the notice, for rectifications of prima facie discrepancies on the records with Commissioner of Income Tax Appellate {"CIT(Appeals)"}. Considering the request for rectification, the CIT has adjusted accumulated losses and issued revised order dated 22.11.2024 with a demand of ₹162.45 lakhs. To accelerate the hearing process, a request letter also submitted with Principal CIT.
tax_litigation.status: The assessment was completed and a demand of ₹ 1,113.19 lakhs was computed. The company have filed rectifications against mistakes prima facie on records & appeal against the disallowances has also been filed with CIT(Appeals). Considering our request on rectification, CIT has adjusted accumulated losses & issued revised order dated 22.11.24 with demand of ₹ 162.45 lakhs. Stay of Demand has been granted by AO on 24/02/2025.Hearing Notice from CIT was received on 18/08/2025 against which we had submitted our ground wise response on 01.09.2025.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Proceedings were initiated u/s 263 of the Act pertaining to sale of shares of Max Neeman BV on January 18, 2019. Demand raised ~ INR 29.33 crores . The Company has received a letter u/s 154 from AO to increase the demand from 27.15 Crs to 29.33 Crs.
tax_litigation.status: The Company filed objections, AO went ahead with an enhanced demand through rectification order dated 22.11.25. The Company again filed rectification dated 12.12.25 with the objections stating that the demand is to be reduced. The matter under section 263 is pending with the High Court. Next date of hearing is February 18, 2026.

operating_notes.text: Out of ₹124.23 crore rights issue proceeds, ₹80.91 crore has been utilized up to March 31, 2026.
Occupancy certificate received for Noida Sector 150 Phase 1 unlocking ₹150 crore in receivables.
Max UK Limited stood dissolved from May 26, 2026.
Liquidity position stood at approximately ₹58 Cr as of March 2026.
Board approved corporate guarantees up to ₹75 Cr for wholly owned subsidiaries Antara Senior Living Limited and/or Antara Assisted Care Services Limited.
Antara's Care Homes operate eight facilities with 485 beds across Gurugram, Noida, Bengaluru and Chennai.
AGEasy, Antara's senior-products store, has touched over 6.5 lakh lives since its 2023 inception.
Antara's first senior living community in Dehradun houses nearly 200 families; a second in Noida Sector-150 has 340 apartments in its first phase.
Antara Senior Care joined the SCALE initiative as a founding industry partner.
Max India executed a ₹40 Cr letter of comfort for Aditya Birla Capital Limited covering a credit facility availed by Antara Senior Living Limited.

timeline.summary: Max UK Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, was dissolved effective May 26, 2026.
Antara Senior Care received a partial occupancy certificate for Phase 1 of its Noida Sector 150 senior living community, unlocking ₹150 crore in receivables.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹65.63 Cr (+58.1% YoY), net loss ₹19.29 Cr (against a loss of ₹46.09 Cr a year earlier).
Max India reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹72 Cr and a net loss of ₹19.3 Cr.
Max India's board approved a ₹75 Cr corporate guarantee for wholly owned subsidiaries and reallocated unutilised rights issue proceeds.
Antara Senior Care, Max India's wholly owned subsidiary, opened the Antara Integrated Wellness Clinic in DLF Phase 2, Gurugram, its first integrative medicine clinic for chronic conditions.
Max India's subsidiary Antara Senior Care joined the SCALE initiative as a founding industry partner on October 13, 2026.

Max India executed a ₹40 Cr letter of comfort in favour of Aditya Birla Capital Limited for a credit facility availed by wholly owned subsidiary Antara Senior Living Limited, updating its May 28, 2026 board intimation.
